Name: First Blood
Text: You killed something. It's on the record now. The record is also on fire, but still.

Name: Hocus, Pocus
Text: Your first spell. I'd say it was beautiful, but I have to say that to everyone.

Name: Four Walls and a Door
Text: A safe room. Try not to cry on the furniture.

Name: Duct Tape Engineer
Text: You made a thing from other things. Ancient and noble. The tape did most of it.

Name: Level Two. Wow.
Text: You leveled up. Everyone does. It's the dying that sets you apart.

Name: Customer Service
Text: You bought something. The management thanks you for your money. The management is lying.

Name: Unwrapping Issues
Text: You opened a box. Look at you, enjoying things.

Name: Pest Control
Text: Ten sump rats. Each of them had a family. A big family. In the walls.

Name: Body Count
Text: Twenty-five kills. The audience has stopped counting and started betting.

Name: Mass Production
Text: A hundred. You've stopped being a crawler and started being a weather event.

Name: Unnecessary Roughness
Hint: Kill something with far more damage than it needed.
Text: {overkill} more damage than it had HP. It was already dead. You were just really, really sure.

Name: Above Your Pay Grade
Text: An elite, down. Somebody's going to have to file paperwork on that.

Name: Lucky Streak
Text: Five natural twenties. The dice have noticed you. This is not a compliment.

Name: One Hit From Funeral
Hint: Win a fight on the edge of death.
Text: You won a fight with {crawler.hp} HP left. That wasn't skill, that was spite.

Name: Moral Victory
Text: Under ten percent. You're a very expensive stain.

Name: Hurt Locker
Text: Two hundred damage taken, lifetime. The building has been doing most of it.

Name: Tourist
Text: Twenty rooms. You're basically a local, if the locals are dying.

Name: Completionist
Text: Sixty rooms. Nobody asked you to look in all of them. And yet.

Name: Floor Manager
Text: A floor, cleared. Another thousand to go. I mean twelve. Fine, thirteen.

Name: Voices in the Walls
Text: Found something that talks. Your pocket's going to want to hear about it.

Name: Hardware Upgrade
Text: You gave your pocket a new part. It said thank you. Twice. Don't get used to it.

Name: Handy Enough
Text: Five crafts. Your inventory now smells of glue and hubris.

Name: Magic Is Just Math, Badly
Text: Twenty casts. Please stop pointing at things and saying words.

Name: Pharmacy Regular
Text: Ten potions. That's not a build, that's an addiction.

Name: Friendly Fire
Hint: Hurt yourself with your own stuff.
Text: You hurt yourself with your own item. That's the most reliable kill on the floor.

Name: Read the Signs
Text: You walked into a trap. In a place that is, I remind you, nothing but traps.

Name: Butterfingers
Text: Three natural ones. You're not unlucky. You're just bad. We checked.

Name: Pocket Lint
Text: Zero gold. Spent it all, I see. Capitalism, huh.

Name: Whale
Text: Five hundred spent. The shopkeepers have started saying your name like a prayer.

Name: Everything Must Go
Text: You sold five things. Most of it was other people's.

Name: Sleeps Like the Dead
Text: You slept well. Nobody sleeps well here. This is suspicious.

Name: Teacher's Pet
Text: I like you. This will pass.

Name: Floor Boss, Meet Floor
Text: A boss, down. Don't get cocky. They make a new one every floor.

Name: Overpaid
Text: Five elites. HR is calling it a pattern of behavior.

Name: Rolling Blackout
Text: Five hundred. The dungeon is hiring replacements slower than you're firing them.

Name: The Dice Have Favorites
Text: Twenty natural twenties. The dice aren't watching you anymore. They work for you now.

Name: Strategic Retreat
Text: You ran away. Tactically. With your back turned. Very tactically.

Name: One Hit Point Wonder
Hint: Survive a hit that leaves you at exactly 1 HP.
Text: One HP. One. The audience loved that. The audience is made of vultures.

Name: Ow. Just Ow.
Hint: Survive a single hit of 20 or more damage.
Text: Twenty damage in one hit and you're still standing. Barely. Aggressively.

Name: Load-Bearing
Text: A thousand damage taken. You're less a crawler than a very motivated punching bag.

Name: Frequent Flyer
Text: A hundred rooms. You've got more miles than the airline.

Name: Wide Awake Club
Text: Exhausted. Your reflexes have filed for leave.

Name: Seeing Things
Text: Delirious. The scouting reports might be lying now. So might you.

Name: Hardware Store Regular
Text: Twenty crafts. Your inventory is sixty percent duct tape and forty percent regret.

Name: Cookbook Author
Text: Ten recipes in the Codex. Somebody's going to find your notes and mistake them for wisdom.

Name: Wizard, Allegedly
Text: A hundred casts. You haven't earned the hat. The hat doesn't care.

Name: Well-Read
Text: Five spells. A library of explosions and a vague sense of unease.

Name: Running on Fumes
Hint: Cast a spell that drains your MP to zero.
Text: Zero mana. You squeezed out the last drop. Proud of you, in an alarming way.

Name: Dragon Complex
Text: A thousand gold, just sitting there. It won't keep you warm. It might get you killed.

Name: Loyalty Program
Text: Twenty purchases. You've been enrolled in a points program. The points are fake.

Name: Gambling Problem
Text: Ten boxes. You're not collecting loot anymore. You're feeding something.

Name: Jackpot
Text: A gold box. Don't spend it all in one place. Spend it all in one place.

Name: Overachiever
Text: Ten achievements. Nobody asked. Nobody's stopping you.

Name: Trophy Case
Text: Twenty-five achievements. You've got a shelf for this. Don't you.

Name: Professional Fumbler
Text: Ten natural ones. You turned failure into a skill. The wrong skill.

Name: Cardio Day
Text: Five retreats. The dungeon has a name for people like you. It's 'repeat customer.'

Name: Eavesdropper
Text: Five shards. Your pocket is starting to string them into sentences. Don't encourage it.

Name: Overclocked
Text: Three upgrades. Your pocket is developing opinions and processing power. Bad combination.

Name: Villain Monologue
Hint: Hear a clue in a boss's throwaway line.
Text: A boss said something it shouldn't have. They always do. It's the only thing they do for free.

Name: Union Buster
Text: A hundred sump rats. The rat union has filed a formal complaint. The union is also dead.

Name: Archivist
Text: Twenty lines in the Codex. Someone is going to read that someday. Probably someone worse than you.

Name: Wardrobe Change
Hint: See every vessel Echo can start a run in.
Text: Handheld, music box, ticket stub, snow globe. Same voice, different outfit.

Name: Pilot Episode
Text: You died. Don't take it personally. The audience didn't.

Name: Rodent Rights
Hint: Be killed by a sump rat.
Text: Killed by a sump rat. The rat has been promoted.

Name: Death by Furniture
Text: Killed by the room. Not an enemy. The room. The room has no sense of fair play.

Name: Tutorial Boss
Text: Floor one. The floor that exists specifically to not kill you. Impressive.

Name: You Can't Take It With You
Text: Died with gold in your pocket. Whoever finds it says thank you.

Name: Rest in Pieces
Text: Died in your sleep. At least you were well rested. For a while.

Name: Boss, Briefly
Hint: Die to a floor boss in the first round.
Text: Round one. The boss barely looked up. You were a formality.

Name: Recurring Customer
Text: Ten deaths. The paperwork has your name pre-printed.
